## Où j'en suis
PostgreSQL 17 upgrade of the analytics RDS (branch noa/rds-pg17, draft PR kestrel-analytics/infra#57): staging is done — pg_partman upgraded to 5.1.0 on 16.4, `rds.logical_replication = 1` added with a reboot, blue/green cutover completed at 14:20 UTC (41 s of refused writes), analytics-staging now runs PG 17.2. dbt ran clean on 17.2 (14 models pass, +3% runtime, within noise). Runbook updated: prod needs a step-0 "set rds.logical_replication = 1 and reboot (~2–3 min downtime)" before its blue/green, so prod needs two windows. No prod date yet: Maya will sign off after a full incident-free week of staging on 17 (sign-off possible from Nov 24). (source: ses-pg-3, src-pr57, src-slack-infra, src-linear-kes298)

- [en-cours] PR kestrel-analytics/infra#57 is open (draft) with commits 7e3c9d4 and b0f18a2 pushed; staging running 17.2 for its one-week soak test (source: ses-pg-3, src-pr57)
- [prochaine-étape] wait for Maya's sign-off after the full week on staging (earliest Nov 24), then pick the production windows — one for the reboot, one for the blue/green switchover, outside the 01:00–03:30 UTC dbt lock (source: ses-pg-3, src-linear-kes298, ses-pg-1)
- [essai-raté] first `terraform apply pg17.plan` failed: blue/green for PostgreSQL requires `rds.logical_replication = 1` in the source parameter group plus a reboot (source: ses-pg-3)
- [essai-raté] `terraform init -upgrade` pulled AWS provider v6 with 37 unrelated plan changes; provider pinned to 5.82 instead (source: ses-pg-1)
- [décision] AWS provider pinned to 5.82, no v6 in this PR (source: s1-02)
- [décision] no prod date until Maya signs off; `apply_immediately` stays false (source: s1-04, src-linear-kes298)
